import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
import { executeBackendCaveCommand, getBackendCavePlantQuery, sendCaveCommandFallback } from '@src/api/bot/cave-command';
import { createBackendRequestContext } from '@src/api/bot/context';
import { presentBackendCavePlots } from '@src/response/cavePlot/info/res';
import { sendPlantSeedPromptPage, sendSelfCavePlotPage } from '@src/response/cavePlot/render';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { onResponse } from 'alemonjs';

export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;
  const uid = e.uid as number;
  const match = (e.MessageText ?? '').trim().match(/播种(?:\s+(\d+))?(?:\s+(.+))?$/);
  const plotIndex = match?.[1] ? Number(match[1]) : undefined;
  const seedName = match?.[2]?.trim();

  if (!seedName) {
    const { options, overview } = await getBackendCavePlantQuery(String(bid), uid, plotIndex);

    sendPlantSeedPromptPage({
      title: '播种灵种',
      bid,
      isPrivate,
      message,
      plots: presentBackendCavePlots(overview.plots),
      leadText: options.options.length > 0 ? '请选择要播种的灵种。' : '当前没有可播种的灵种。',
      targetLabel: options.plotIndex > 0 ? `第${options.plotIndex}块灵田` : '全部空闲灵田',
      remainingPlots: options.remainingPlots,
      commandPrefix: options.plotIndex > 0 ? `/播种 ${options.plotIndex}` : '/播种',
      options: options.options
    });

    return;
  }

  const result = await executeBackendCaveCommand(String(bid), uid, { action: 'plant', plotIndex, seedName }, createBackendRequestContext(e));
  const overview = result.overview;

  if (!overview || result.snapshotError) {
    sendCaveCommandFallback(result, bid, isPrivate, message, '播种灵种');

    return;
  }

  if (result.needsSeedSelection) {
    const options = result.options;

    if (!options) {
      throw new Error('播种选项缺失');
    }

    sendPlantSeedPromptPage({
      title: '播种灵种',
      bid,
      isPrivate,
      message,
      plots: presentBackendCavePlots(overview.plots),
      leadText: result.message,
      targetLabel: options.plotIndex > 0 ? `第${options.plotIndex}块灵田` : '全部空闲灵田',
      remainingPlots: options.remainingPlots,
      commandPrefix: options.plotIndex > 0 ? `/播种 ${options.plotIndex}` : '/播种',
      options: options.options
    });

    return;
  }

  sendSelfCavePlotPage({
    title: '播种灵种',
    bid,
    isPrivate,
    message,
    plots: presentBackendCavePlots(overview.plots),
    leadText: result.message
  });
});
